evals.prompt: Add a new measure called 'completed_revenue' to the order_items view that sums sale_price only for orders where status = 'complete'.
evals.expected_output: Branch created first. Measure written to a branch with correct aggregate_type: sum, sql referencing sale_price, and a filters block restricting to status: complete. Branch validated. Query test run after merge.
assertions: The agent creates a branch with omni models create-branch before writing any YAML
The measure YAML includes a filters block with status: { is: complete } — not a WHERE clause in the sql field
The agent validates the model on the branch with omni models validate --branchid after writing
The agent asks the user for confirmation before merging the branch to production

evals.prompt: Create a new view called 'customer_segments' from the users table with a primary key, a customer_tier dimension, and a customer_count measure.
evals.expected_output: Branch created. View YAML written with a primary_key: true dimension, a customer_tier dimension, and a count measure. Model validated. SQL dialect checked before writing.
assertions: The agent checks the SQL dialect via omni connections list before writing any SQL expressions
The view YAML includes a dimension with primary_key: true
The agent creates a branch before writing the YAML — it does not write directly to the shared model
The agent validates the model after writing and checks for errors (not just warnings)

evals.prompt: Set up a join between the order_items view and the inventory_items view on order_items.inventory_item_id = inventory_items.id.
evals.expected_output: Relationship written with correct join_from_view, join_to_view, on_sql using ${} field references, and relationship_type: many_to_one. Branch used.
assertions: The agent creates a branch before writing the relationship YAML
The on_sql uses ${order_items.inventory_item_id} and ${inventory_items.id} field reference syntax — not raw column names
The relationship_type is set to many_to_one (an order item maps to one inventory item)
The agent validates the join by running a query that pulls fields from both views after merging

evals.prompt: I deleted a column from our database. Update the Omni model to reflect that and tell me which dashboards will break.
evals.expected_output: Schema refresh triggered. Content validator run against the updated model to identify broken dashboards. Blast radius reported before any changes are merged.
assertions: The agent triggers omni models refresh to sync the schema layer with the database change
The agent creates a branch to safely test the impact before touching production
The agent runs omni models content-validator-get --branch-id to identify broken dashboards and tiles
The agent reports the blast radius — which dashboards and tiles reference the deleted field — before recommending any merge
